introduction: DC weatherization helps qualifying homes become more energy efficient. DOEE’s current page reports delayed WAP openings, so confirm availability before applying.
description: DC weatherization helps qualifying homes become more energy efficient. DOEE’s current page reports delayed WAP openings, so confirm availability before applying.

sections.who: Eligible properties must house qualifying households and meet property conditions. Rentals and multifamily buildings have additional participation requirements.
sections.get: An energy audit selects efficiency and related safety measures. WAP is not a general renovation service and does not accept payment for its work.
sections.docs:
• Household identity and income records.
  • Utility bills and requested ownership, bank or insurance records.
  • The current combined application and any additional forms DOEE requests.
sections.apply:
1. Confirm intake status

    Review DOEE WAP or call 202-299-3316.

  2. Use the current application instructions

    Ask which combined EMS-LRP-WAP and LIHEAP forms are required and how to submit records.

  3. Arrange the home assessment

    If accepted, DOEE evaluates the home and coordinates eligible measures through contractors.
sections.after: For an existing waiting-list case, watch for DOEE contact. Ask the assigned nonprofit about scheduling after approval.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DOEE WAP services and current status. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
